title: The White Dragon Spiritual Pearl
summary: The Black Dragon Sovereign's doppelganger confronts the White Dragon Sovereign's residual image over the Dragon Demon Palace treasure he hid centuries ago; the two old friends fight, and the image is worn down until the barrier breaks. Inside, statue guards attack, and Su Xuan shows her Heavy Water Spiritual Bead; when Bai Xuan splits his men, Mu Chen goes after Bai Dong alone, using the White Dragon Token to partly control the statues. In the depths he finds the White Dragon Spiritual Pearl beside an ominous stone pillar that Jiuyou warns him away from. Bai Dong and his guards, at initial-phase Heavenly Transformation, attack him, and Mu Chen crushes them with the White Tiger Divine Seal, leaving Bai Dong half dead. Bai Xuan arrives in a rage, the others catch up, and Bai Xuan reveals his real realm: late-phase Heavenly Transformation.

cultivation: Bai Xuan reveals Heavenly Transformation, Late Phase (up from the middle phase he showed in EP48). Bai Dong's guards are at initial-phase Heavenly Transformation; Mu Chen beats them from middle-phase Heavenly Fusion. The White Dragon and Black Dragon Sovereigns fight as a residual image and a doppelganger.
